answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32904 Country: India Title: While offering salah is it correct to recite "Hamdan Kasiran Taiybban Mubarakan Kama Yuhibbo Yarza" after finsing the RUKU and Before going to Sajda. Question: While offering salah is it correct to recite "Hamdan Kasiran Taiybban Mubarakan Kama Yuhibbo Yarza" after finsing the RUKU and Before going to Sajda. Secondaly, is it correct to recite Dua while performing Sajda. Please suggest me the right way as I am practicing this and this helps me to concentrate on salah. Answer ID: 32904 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1002/832/B=1432) If you offer salah alone you may read this dua in Qauma whereas it is not proved to read it in sajdah. There we should read the dua of sajdah i. e. سبحان ربى الاعلى. However, between both the two sajdahs we can read اللهم اغفرلى وارحمنى واهدنى وارزقنى وعافنى. In-sha-Allah, this act shall cause interest and concentration in salah and thus the reward will be increased. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
